description: This Java class, SearchRequest, defines a data transfer object (DTO) used for filtering and paginating search results for receipts, including filters such as user ID, query text, category, vendor, date range, and pagination options.

classes.name: SearchRequest
classes.description: A DTO class representing search filters for receipt searches, including attributes for user ID, query, category, vendor, date range, and paging information.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID filter for the search.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user ID filter for the search.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns the free-text query string for the search.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the free-text query string for the search.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category filter for the search.

methods.name: setCategory
methods.description: Sets the category filter for the search.

methods.name: getVendor
methods.description: Returns the vendor filter for the search.

methods.name: setVendor
methods.description: Sets the vendor filter for the search.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date filter for the search.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date filter for the search.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date filter for the search.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date filter for the search.

methods.name: getPage
methods.description: Returns the current page number for pagination.

methods.name: setPage
methods.description: Sets the page number for pagination.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the page size for pagination.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the page size for pagination.
